     Update "version" and the lists with each release. -->
version: 0.4.4
tagline: An enrage countdown on bosses, dungeon bosses fully recognised, and a lighter meter.

## New
- ⏱ **Enrage countdown** on the boss card, amber in the last minute and 🔥 when the boss enrages
- 🏰 **Dungeon bosses fully recognised:** Conquest Vakron and friends get their picture, type and rank
- ⚡ **Lighter on your PC:** the overlay only redraws what changed, so it does almost no work between fights
- 🔵 **Your server stays in the footer** while idle, with a blue connection light
- ✨ **Tidier player list:** a soft line under the header, and the column you rank by is gold

## Changed
- 💤 The idle light dims three times, then rests as a steady glow
